age.evidence: Adult (2-5 months of age) male Wistar rats (Harlan Laboratories, Indianapolis, IN)

sex.evidence: Adult (2-5 months of age) male Wistar rats ... rats with intact pineal glands (n = 25 ...) and pinealectomized rats (n = 11 ...)

group_housing.evidence: The animals were returned to their cages, housed individually, and allowed to recover from the surgery for 7 days before microdialysis recording proceeded.

day_night_flipped.evidence: All animals were housed in an 12:12 light:dark cycle in a controlled light environment (250 Lux at the cage level). The 12 hours of light began at 6 am and the 12 hours of dark began at 6 pm.

judge_notes: No behavioural assays were scored: the paper measures endogenous DMT in brain microdialysates and INMT/AADC mRNA expression. No exogenous psychedelic was administered, and no behavioural paradigm was performed (microdialysis with HPLC and cardiac-arrest induction are neurochemical/physiological endpoints, not behavioural assays).
All three candidates agreed there are zero scorable assays; consolidated output preserves study-level metadata only.
Dosing list is empty because no psychedelic compound was administered to the animals; endogenous DMT measurement does not constitute dosing.
